ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, if all the algae die, which species will starve?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the food web is Algae (algae), and there is an arrow pointing from Algae to Rotifer (rotifer). This indicates that rotifer feeds on algae or directly depends on algae. The diagram also shows that Rotifer is connected afterward to Artemia, Mysid, and seahorse-related species, but what is most directly related to “all algae die” in the question is the food relationship from Algae to Rotifer. Reasoning: If all algae die, then Rotifer, which directly eats algae, loses its food source and therefore will starve. The answer is rotifer.
